spec.description:
Paroc Rockwool is a
premium European-engineered stone wool insulation made from volcanic basalt
rock, designed for superior thermal, acoustic, and passive fire protection
across building and industrial applications. Non-combustible with an
exceptionally high melting point exceeding 1000°C, Paroc stone wool does not
shrink, melt, or produce toxic smoke during a fire, maintaining fire
compartmentation. Distributed internationally and used across Australia in
high-performance facades, roofs, and acoustic partitions, it is water repellent,
vapour permeable, and dimensionally stable.
features:
Manufactured from
natural volcanic basalt stone

Non-combustible with a melting point
exceeding 1000°C
Exceptional passive fire resistance preventing fire spread
Outstanding acoustic sound absorption and vibration damping

High thermal
insulation performance with low thermal conductivity

Dimensionally stable,
will not sag, slump, or shrink over time

Water-repellent and non-hygroscopic;
resists moisture absorption

Highly vapour permeable, allowing building
structures to dry out

Chemically inert and does not promote corrosion of
metal framing

Biosoluble fibers meeting international health and safety
standards

technical.value: Stone wool (rock mineral wool made from volcanic basalt)
30 kg/m³ to 150 kg/m³ (depending on product grade)

Short term: ≤ 1
kg/m²; Long term: ≤ 3 kg/m²

spec.fire:
Euroclass A1 non-combustible
to EN 13501-1; Non-combustible to AS 1530.1; Melting point > 1000°C; FRLs up
to 240 minutes in tested assemblies
spec.compliance:
EN 13162, AS 1530.1,
AS 1530.4, CE marked, NCC compliant non-combustible material
spec.sustainability:
Natural volcanic rock; 100% recyclable; low embodied emissions; zero ODP;
biosoluble fibers
install:
Cut stone wool slabs or batts cleanly using a
dedicated serrated insulation knife

Friction-fit batts snugly into timber or
steel stud bays, ensuring no voids along framing edges

For external facades
and rainscreens, mechanically secure slabs using approved insulation anchors
with large washer heads

Ensure adjacent slabs are tightly butted in a
staggered brick-bond pattern to eliminate thermal bridging

Maintain
ventilation gaps where specified behind rainscreen cladding systems

Wear
gloves, goggles, and a dust mask during cutting and handling
selection_checklist:
Confirm target application (fire-rated wall,
rainscreen facade, acoustic partition, or industrial pipe)

Verify density and
thickness required to satisfy fire FRL and thermal R-value specifications
Ensure non-combustible AS 1530.1 compliance is required by project engineer
Order appropriate mechanical fasteners and washers
limitations:
Heavier than glasswool
or polyester batts; ensure framing accounts for dead load

Protect from
continuous rain exposure during construction prior to building envelope
sealing
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment during handling
spec.warranty: Backed by Paroc manufacturer product warranty

problem_keywords: flammable insulation risks in high-rise buildings

high
temperature melting of insulation in fire

acoustic noise transfer through
commercial walls
use_cases:
Non-combustible external wall and rainscreen facade insulation on multi-storey
commercial towers

Passive fire containment and sound insulation in party
walls, drywall partitions, and service shafts

High-temperature thermal and
acoustic insulation on industrial pipework, boilers, and plant rooms
not_for: Direct unshielded exposure to permanent outdoor weather
retrieval.rag_summary:
Paroc Rockwool is a premium
non-combustible stone wool insulation manufactured from volcanic basalt rock,
engineered for fire containment, acoustic damping, and thermal performance.
Featuring a melting point exceeding 1000°C and Euroclass A1 / AS 1530.1
non-combustibility, it maintains structural integrity under fire conditions
without shrinking or emitting toxic smoke. Water-repellent, vapour-permeable,
and dimensionally stable, it delivers high-performance acoustic and thermal
protection across commercial facades, partition walls, roofs, and industrial
applications.
